about_the_game:
🌊 Submeris

A deep-sea mining adventure filled with exploration, danger, and survival beneath a mysterious island!

Dig. Upgrade. Descend. And uncover the treasure buried deep below.

---

🎮 About the Game

Submeris invites you into an immersive underwater experience combining exploration, mining mechanics, and survival gameplay beneath a remote and mysterious island.

Start with just a simple shovel. Level up, upgrade your gear, and dive deeper into the unknown. But beware — limited oxygen, rising radiation, collapsing tunnels, and deadly sharks all stand between you and the ultimate treasure.

The deeper you go, the greater the reward — and the risk.

---

⚒️ Dig – Upgrade – Descend

  • Upgrade your shovel and pickaxe – dig faster and break stronger materials
  • Use dynamite and tools – break through obstacles and discover new paths
  • Enhance your light source – illuminate dark tunnels below
  • Expand your inventory – carry more loot, earn more profit
  • Boost oxygen and radiation resistance – dive longer and go deeper

---

💰 High Risk, Greater Reward

In the depths, precious minerals, hidden chests, and legendary treasures await. But only the most prepared divers can survive the hazards below.

  • Radiation zones with time pressure
  • Unstable tunnels at risk of collapse
  • And most dangerously — sharks guarding the final treasure

Every layer hides danger, but also opportunity.

---

🎯 Who Is This Game For?

Submeris is made for players who enjoy:
  • Atmospheric exploration
  • Mining and digging gameplay
  • Survival and resource management
  • Progression through risk vs reward
  • Dark, mysterious underwater environments

---

🚀 Key Features

  • Depth-based leveling and progression system
  • Upgradeable tools: shovel, pickaxe, lamp, dynamite, inventory
  • Strategic survival with oxygen & radiation mechanics
  • Sell valuable minerals and discover rare treasures
  • Unlock secret rooms, loot hidden chests, survive deadly encounters
  • Realistic underwater atmosphere and dynamic lighting system
  • Shark threats in deep treasure zones

---

🔚 Ready to dive deep? Hold your breath... and descend.

“True treasure lies only where the bold dare to go.”

  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 10

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660S
